name: חֶפְצִי־בָהּ
summary: Hephzibah was the mother of Manasseh king of Judah. Isaiah gives the same name to restored Zion and explains it by saying that Yahweh delights in her.

evidence.note: The name חֶפְצִי־בָהּ is explained by חָפֵץ יַהְוֶה בָּךְ, “Yahweh delights in you.”

note: The personal name and the name spoken over Zion share the spelling. TIPNR identifies one woman.
